durability.evidence: The tracked producer, corpus, actual public receipt, whole program epochs and complete replay bind all inputs and preserve the selected-current versus unmeasured-original boundary.

falsify.competing_hypothesis: A copied prefix could replace a full source value, a wrong length profile could be accepted, or bounded displays could be promoted to original runtime identity.
falsify.evidence: Separate source traversal and token reconstruction check every full value/header/trace under both explicit profiles; complete lost-tail, wrong-token, profile-borrowing and original-flag-promotion candidates reject at their intended contracts.

rederive.evidence: The selected current public corpus explicitly assigns argument-length profiles 64 and 0 before observation and preserves every full scalar value; numeric displays and undefined values retain their exact cases.
